subject: The Power Stone
body:
A Starlit Factory! That means you can make a Cosmic Worm. Forge one from a Fire Dragon Heart, an Ice Dragon Heart and a Lightning Dragon Heart, with a Viltrumite Blood Sample, Pure Darkness and a Worm Tooth.

Use the Worm under open sky in the Overworld or Elythia and the Devourer of Gods comes for it. Beat him and the Power Stone is yours. Each Worm only works once.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
